metadata.question: Was the vegetation health (NDVI) in Namibia worse in February 21-28 2019, compared to the long-term average for the same month period from 2003 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good NDVI quality post-2015) or MODIS (covers full 2003-2017). - For 2019: Feb 21-28, 2019 - For baseline: Feb 21-28, aggregated from 2003-2017 - Location: Namibia (feature collection or bounding box) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Apply cloud masking (SCL band for Sentinel-2, or QA for MODIS). - Calculate NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) - Use mean NDVI across valid pixels as the metric. 3. **Logic**: - Calculate mean NDVI for Feb 21-28 2019. - Calculate mean NDVI for Feb 21-28 across 2003-2017 (long-term average). - Compare: if 2019 NDVI < baseline NDVI, answer is **A (Yes, worse)**. - If 2019 NDVI >= baseline NDVI, answer is **B (No, not worse)**. - Handle edge cases: C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (NaN/invalid values). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Namibia geometry const namibia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Namibia')); const geom = namibia.geometry(); // Function to calculate NDVI from Sentinel-2 function addNDVI(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return img.addBands(ndvi); } // Function to mask clouds using SCL function maskClouds(img) { const scl = img.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return img.updateMask(mask); } // Fallback to MODIS if Sentinel-2 fails function addNDVIModis(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B2', 'B1']).rename('NDVI'); return img.addBands(ndvi); } function maskModis(img) { const qa = img.select('StateQA'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0); // Good quality pixels return img.updateMask(mask); } // 2019 Feb 21-28 let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate('2019-02-21', '2019-02-29') .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); let size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log('2019 Sentinel-2 images:', size2019); // Fallback to MODIS for 2019 if no Sentinel-2 if (size2019 === 0) { col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate('2019-02-21', '2019-02-29') .map(maskModis) .map(addNDVIModis); size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log('2019 MODIS images (fallback):', size2019); } if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI for 2019 const img2019 = col2019.mean(); const count2019 = img2019.select('NDVI') .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (count2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in 2019 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const ndvi2019 = img2019.select('NDVI') .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log('2019 NDVI:', ndvi2019, '| Valid pixels:', count2019); // Baseline 2003-2017, Feb 21-28 let colBaseline = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(geom) .filter(ee.Filter.daysBetween({ 'start': ee.Date('2003-02-21'), 'end': ee.Date('2017-02-28'), 'leftField': 'system:time_start' })) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(21, 28, 'day_of_year')) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); let sizeBaseline = colBaseline.size().getInfo(); console.log('Baseline Sentinel-2 images:', sizeBaseline); // Fallback to MODIS if (sizeBaseline === 0) { colBaseline = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .filterBounds(geom) .filter(ee.Filter.daysBetween({ 'start': ee.Date('2003-02-21'), 'end': ee.Date('2017-02-28'), 'leftField': 'system:time_start' })) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(21, 28, 'day_of_year')) .map(maskModis) .map(addNDVIModis); sizeBaseline = colBaseline.size().getInfo(); console.log('Baseline MODIS images (fallback):', sizeBaseline); } if (sizeBaseline === 0) { console.log('No baseline data (2003-2017).'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI for baseline const imgBaseline = colBaseline.mean(); const countBaseline = imgBaseline.select('NDVI') .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (countBaseline === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in baseline after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const ndviBaseline = imgBaseline.select('NDVI') .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log('Baseline NDVI (2003-2017, Feb 21-28):', ndviBaseline, '| Valid pixels:', countBaseline); // Validation: check for NaN or invalid values if (ndvi2019 === null || ndvi2019 === undefined || isNaN(ndvi2019) || ndviBaseline === null || ndviBaseline === undefined || isNaN(ndviBaseline)) { console.log('Calculation failed: NaN or invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare console.log('Comparison: 2019 NDVI (' + ndvi2019.toFixed(4) + ') vs Baseline (' + ndviBaseline.toFixed(4) + ')'); if (ndvi2019 < ndviBaseline) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
